children: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals terminated its at-the-market equity Sales Agreement with SVB Leerink and Cantor Fitzgerald, effective at the merger closing with Vertex. The agreement, originally dated June 21, 2024, was ended as trading in Crinetics shares was suspended and the stock will be delisted from Nasdaq. The termination appears to be early and tied to the change in control, with no exit fees disclosed. As a wholly owned subsidiary, Crinetics no longer requires a public equity issuance facility.
